## Maya Chen

Maya Chen is a delivery manager in the Project Management Office. She coordinates project schedules and review handoffs. Project charters, rather than this directory, establish her assignments to individual projects.

## Daniel Ortiz

Daniel Ortiz is Chief Operating Officer in the Executive Office. He handles executive escalations for internal operations. An executive role or sponsorship does not establish approval of an individual project decision; consult the relevant decision record.

## Alex Morgan

Alex Morgan is a data engineer in the Data Platform team. Alex Morgan implements data-quality checks and maintains ingestion validation workflows. Alex Morgan is a different person from Alex Rivera.

## Alex Rivera

Alex Rivera is a risk analyst in the Risk Analytics team. Alex Rivera maps the lineage of internal risk reporting inputs and reviews reporting dependencies. Alex Rivera is a different person from Alex Morgan.

## Priya Shah

Priya Shah is a compliance operations analyst in the Compliance Operations team. Her responsibilities include assessing evidence workflows and coordinating evidence completeness reviews. Compliance Operations is a team within the Compliance Office.

## Elena Brooks

Elena Brooks is Head of Compliance and leads the Compliance Office. She reviews operational control proposals. Approval authority for a particular decision must be established from its decision record, not inferred from her title.

## Noah Singh

Noah Singh is the Data Platform team lead. His responsibilities include platform access reviews and delivery coordination for shared data services. The Data Platform team supports internal operational systems.

## Sofia Alvarez

Sofia Alvarez is the Risk Analytics team lead. She coordinates risk-reporting review work and maintains the team's operational reporting inventory.

## Delivery coordination

Maya Chen has the skill Delivery Coordination. It covers coordinating schedules, dependencies, and review handoffs across project participants. It is different from approving a control proposal.

## Data quality engineering

Alex Morgan has the skill Data Quality Engineering. It covers implementing ingestion checks, validating required fields, and investigating incomplete operational data. Alex Rivera is not assigned this skill in this register; do not transfer a skill between people because they share a first name.

## Access governance

Noah Singh has the skill Access Governance. It covers reviewing access requirements, ownership, and least-privilege rules for internal platforms. It does not establish who approved any particular access decision.

## Risk lineage mapping

Alex Rivera and Sofia Alvarez have the skill Risk Lineage Mapping. It covers tracing internal risk-reporting inputs through dependencies to their source systems. It does not include forecasting investment performance or guaranteeing returns.

Beacon Evidence Hub organizes compliance evidence records and their review ownership. Its operational owner is the Compliance Office.
Harbor Access Register records access-request ownership and review outcomes. Its operational owner is the Data Platform team.
Signal Lineage Board records internal risk-reporting dependencies and source lineage. Its operational owner is the Risk Analytics team.
LedgerCheck checks whether required compliance evidence is complete. Priya Shah maintains its evidence-completeness rule catalogue. LedgerCheck does not organize the evidence repository itself.

## Decision and project

Decision DEC-001 selects Beacon Evidence Hub as the evidence organization tool for Project Atlas. The decision was approved on October 12, 2026. It concerns internal compliance operations, not investment selection or expected returns.

## Approval and accountability

Elena Brooks, Head of Compliance, approved DEC-001. Priya Shah prepared the evidence workflow assessment supporting the recommendation. Preparing an assessment is a different responsibility from approving the decision.

The Project Atlas charter records the project's lead and executive sponsor. Those project roles do not establish who approved DEC-001; this decision record is the authority for that approval.

## Approval and accountability
